hub.title: Integrations
hub.description: The outside services Mawred uses, and whether they're working.

email.name: Email
email.description: Approvals, reminders and invitations by email, through your SMTP service.

whatsapp_official.name: WhatsApp (Official)
whatsapp_official.description: Meta's WhatsApp Business Cloud API: templates, delivery receipts and one-tap approvals.

whatsapp_waha.name: Unofficial — WhatsApp Web (WAHA)
whatsapp_waha.description: A WhatsApp Web session on a phone you pair. Risk of the number being banned; approvals use links.

cognito.name: Cognito Forms
cognito.description: Entries from Cognito forms become requests in Mawred.
Each source is a Cognito form whose entries become requests. Cognito posts every new, changed and deleted entry here.
cognito.newSourceHelp: You'll get three webhook URLs to paste into the form's Post JSON settings.
cognito.noSourcesHelp: Add a source for each Cognito form you want to bring in.
cognito.notLinked: Not linked to a request type yet
cognito.today: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing in the last day} one {{formatted} entry in the last day} other {{formatted} entries in the last day}}
cognito.waiting: {count, plural, one {{formatted} needs a person} other {{formatted} need a person}}
cognito.logHelp: Everything Cognito sent, kept as it arrived. Replay an entry after fixing the mapping.
cognito.pickPersonHelp: Nobody matched this entry. Choose who it is from; their request then starts.
cognito.personHelp: How Mawred finds the employee in each entry.
cognito.name: Name
cognito.formUrl: Public link to the Cognito form
cognito.urlsOnce: These URLs contain a secret. They're shown in full only now.
cognito.urlsHelp: The secret part is hidden. Rotate to get new URLs; the old ones stop working at once.
cognito.copyNow: Copy all three into Cognito now: you won't see them again.
cognito.noHeaders: Cognito can't send custom headers, so the secret is part of the URL. Keep it private.
cognito.rotateHelp: New URLs are issued and the current ones stop working immediately. Update the form in Cognito straight away.
cognito.sampleHelp: Capture a real entry to see Cognito's field names.
cognito.mappingHelp: For each field of the request form, the Cognito field that fills it. Suggestions come from the sample.
cognito.mappingNoForm: Link a request type to map its form fields.
cognito.prefillHelp: Cognito fields to fill in when an employee opens the form from Mawred (shown in the link, so only these).

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Send notifications and one-tap approvals over WhatsApp. Email stays as the fallback.
whatsapp.driverHelp: Official is Meta's supported API. The unofficial driver runs WhatsApp Web on a phone you pair; it can be banned, so use it as a fallback.

official.name: Official
official.help: Meta's Cloud API: approved templates, delivery receipts and one-tap approvals.

waha.name: Unofficial — WhatsApp Web (WAHA)
waha.help: A paired phone. Plain messages; approvals by link. Risk of the number being banned.

both.name: Both
both.help: Official first, with the unofficial driver as a fallback where you choose.

official.title: WhatsApp (Official)
official.help: From your app in Meta for Developers → WhatsApp → API setup.
official.webhookHelp: In Meta, set the callback URL and verify token, then subscribe to the messages field.

whatsapp.secretsKept: Saved secrets aren't shown again. Leave a field empty to keep it.

templates.title: Message templates
templates.help: Approved templates are needed outside the 24-hour window. Sync after creating or editing them in Meta.

whatsapp.needNumber: Add and confirm your own WhatsApp number in notification settings to send a test.

waha.risk: The unofficial driver uses WhatsApp Web. WhatsApp may ban the number, and there are no delivery receipts. Approvals over it always use links.
waha.help: The WAHA sidecar on your private network.
waha.pairHelp: Start the session, then scan the QR with WhatsApp → Linked devices on the company phone.
waha.webhook: Mawred receives the sidecar's events at
waha.scan: Open WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device, and scan.

routing.title: Routing
routing.help: For each kind of notification, the ways to reach people outside the app, tried in order. Email always comes last.
routing.warning: A critical category uses only the unofficial driver for WhatsApp. If the number is banned, people learn about it only by email.
routing.order: Order: Official → Unofficial → Email. People only get WhatsApp after confirming their number.
routing.codeHelp: An approved authentication template with one variable, used to send number-confirmation codes on Official.

invite.title: Invite people
invite.help: Everyone without a confirmed number gets an in-app and email message explaining how to connect WhatsApp.
